subject: Consolidated renewal: observability retention add-ons & credit request
messages:
From: Rachel Greene <rachel@brightscale.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Patel <j.patel@brightscale.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Upcoming renewal & add-on consolidation options

Hi Michael —

Quick heads-up: our procurement team is preparing the renewal packet for BrightScale's observability estate (Datadog, Grafana Cloud, Sentry). We noticed overlapping retention addons across the three vendors and wanted to propose a consolidated renewal to simplify billing and potentially surface a cross-vendor credit.

Attached are the Q2 invoices and a snapshot of current retention tiers per product.

Options we can discuss:
- Combine yearly commitment for retention across products (single PO)
- Time-limited credit for overlapping data egress/retention billed twice
- 30/60/90 day migration window to consolidate exports

Are you available this week for a 30 min sync? Jordan will join to walk through the invoice detail.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Greene
Strategic Procurement | BrightScale
(attachment: BrightScale_DD_invoices_Q2.pdf)
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Upcoming renewal & add-on consolidation options

Thanks Rachel — looping in Finance (Laura) and Product Ops (Marissa) to confirm what we can offer and to pull a usage-backed credit ask.

Laura / Marissa / Ben — BrightScale is asking about a consolidated renewal and potential credit for overlapping retention. Quick priorities:
1) Can Finance run a bill delta for the last 3 months showing overlap (Datadog + Grafana + Sentry retention spikes)? I attached the BrightScale invoices Rachel sent.
2) Product Ops — what migration window and technical assignment would we propose for a consolidated retention plan (how long to move prefixes/exports)?
3) Legal/commercial: are we ok proposing a one-time credit tied to a signed 12-month consolidated PO or do we need escalation?

We should aim to propose a measurable credit (dollar amount or percentage) and clear migration milestones. I can take the external call Thursday afternoon if that works.

-Michael
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
(attachment: forward: BrightScale_DD_invoices_Q2.pdf)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-19T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Upcoming renewal & add-on consolidation options

Michael — I ran the preliminary invoice roll-up. Summary here (full spreadsheet attached):

- Verified overlapping retention charges across Datadog and Grafana for three hosts/environments; Sentry shows retention addon billed separately for session replays.
- Total overlapping charges (last 90 days): $38,400 (Datadog) + $14,200 (Grafana) + $6,900 (Sentry) = $59,500 gross.
- Realistic credit range without executive sign-off: 10-20% of overlap (approx $5.9k - $11.9k). With a consolidated 12m commitment and migration milestones, Legal/Revenue Ops can approve up to 30% (approx $17.9k).

Attachments: grafana-cloud-pricing-snapshot.xlsx, sentry-retention-addendum.pdf (redacted PII).

Ask: If we want to push toward the 25-30% band, we need a signed note of intent and high-level migration plan before EOD Friday so I can pitch to RevOps. If we go lower (10-15%), I can approve directly.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Finance Partner, Commercials
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-19T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Upcoming renewal & add-on consolidation options

Quick tech note for the call with BrightScale:
- Consolidation path: we recommend routing retention ingests from Grafana -> S3 long-term via our export agent and enabling Datadog prefix dedupe; that reduces double-ingest costs within 4 weeks for most customers.
- Migration milestones: discovery (1 week), agent rollout (2 weeks), validation (1 week), final cutover (2 weeks). Total ~6 weeks.
- Risk: session replay exports from Sentry require a schema change for compressed chunks — we can support but need 2-week developer sprint on BrightScale side.

I support recommending a 25% credit contingent on a signed PO and the six-week migration plan. I'll draft the technical milestone checklist for the call.

-Marissa
Product Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Greene <rachel@brightscale.com>, Jordan Patel <j.patel@brightscale.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Upcoming renewal & add-on consolidation options — proposed path

Rachel / Jordan — thanks for the patience while we pulled the numbers together. Proposed Redwood path: 

1) Credit offer: 25% of documented overlap (we'll apply against first invoice after consolidation) pending a signed 12-month consolidated PO and execution of the migration milestones. Based on the roll-up that equates to a ~$14.9k credit.
2) Migration plan: 6-week plan as outlined by Marissa (discovery, rollout, validation, cutover). BrightScale devs to own the Sentry schema sprint (2 weeks); Redwood will assign an engineer for weekly checkpoints.
3) Evidence & docs: we'll share the detailed invoice roll-up (internal spreadsheet) and provide the retention export playbook. I attached the public snapshot and the addendum we will use for Sentry.
4) Next steps: if this works, sign a Letter of Intent by EOD Friday (DocuSign link below) and schedule a 30-min kickoff Thursday 5/21 10:00am PT.

DocuSign (LOI): https://app.hellosign.com/sig/example-doclink
Internal roll-up (read-only): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Axy-example-internal-invoice-rollup

Can you confirm and I will route to Legal for final language?

Best,
Michael Grant
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
